title: MeshCore · remote repeaters
description: Remote repeater status collected over RF by an on-device Lua monitor and published through the shared modem's native HTTPS telemetry service.

options.content:
Select the **Monitor device** and **Remote repeater**. The monitor collects authenticated status, supported battery voltage and remote radio statistics. Target and monitor must use the same radio profile; **Frequency mismatch** sends no request.

Polls normally run every 300 seconds. Flood discovery defaults to 900 seconds between requests; change it with `bot repeaters discovery SECONDS`. **Poll wait** and **Next eligible poll** explain delays. Adverts do not supply status samples.

The publisher rotates three peers per 60-second report. **Remote report age** measures upload activity; **RF sample age** measures collection. Measurements retain their RF sample timestamp across failed polls and repeated uploads. **Sample hold** draws last-known gauge values for a bounded window, not new RF readings. Current voltage still requires fresh status; rates use the original counter observations. Missing data is not zero.

panels.title: RF sample age
panels.description: Age of the last RF measurement retained in the selected History window, including across monitor restarts. Older firmware uses its published sample-age field.

panels.title: Next eligible poll
panels.description: Countdown from the latest timing report. Eligibility still depends on clock, permissions and shared airtime. Disabled or frequency-fenced targets have no countdown.

panels.title: Current battery voltage
panels.description: Supported voltage only, gated by native fresh state and a report received within 360 seconds. No battery percentage or assumed discharge curve.

panels.title: Battery voltage history
panels.description: Last RF voltage held for Sample hold, then a gap. A held segment is not a new RF response; inspect RF sample age and freshness.

panels.title: Sample availability and freshness · state history
panels.description: Sampled available and fresh flags, held for at most six minutes to cover publisher rotation. Upload gaps remain unknown, not offline.

panels.title: Repeater receive signal and noise
panels.description: Remote radio's last received packet and noise floor, not the monitor's reception of the reply or a directed-link probe.

panels.title: Packet rates
panels.description: Reset-aware rates of remote counters. Five-minute minimum step gives a rate window spanning at least four normal polls; cached exports do not represent additional RF polls.

panels.title: Returned error flags
panels.description: Sampled remote status flags: zero is clear; nonzero needs inspection. These are remote firmware flags, separate from the monitor result. Inspect meshcore_repeater_error_flags in Explore for the raw bitmask.

panels.title: Monitor request attempts and failures
panels.description: Local monitor counters, not the remote radio's packet counters. Frequency-fenced targets send no requests.

panels.title: Monitor result history
panels.description: Last reported monitor state, held for at most six minutes; gaps are unknown. This is a sampled state, not an RF reception event.

panels.title: Poll wait history
panels.description: Last reported monitor state, held for at most six minutes; gaps are unknown. This is a sampled state, not an RF reception event.

panels.title: Battery voltage · 30-minute mean
panels.description: 30-minute time-weighted mean, sampled every minute with RF voltage held for at most six minutes. Requires four distinct RF observations spanning 20 minutes and fresh status. Duplicate uploads do not increase the observation count or weighting.

targets.expr: avg_over_time((last_over_time(meshcore_repeater_battery_volts{device=~"${device:regex}",peer=~"${peer:regex}"}[360s]))[30m:60s]) and ((((last_over_time(meshcore_repeater_battery_volts{device=~"${device:regex}",peer=~"${peer:regex}"}[$history]) and (tlast_over_time(meshcore_repeater_battery_volts{device=~"${device:regex}",peer=~"${peer:regex}"}[$history]) == last_over_time(meshcore_repeater_sample_time_seconds{device=~"${device:regex}",peer=~"${peer:regex}"}[$history]))) or (last_over_time(meshcore_repeater_battery_volts{device=~"${device:regex}",peer=~"${peer:regex}"}[$history]) unless last_over_time(meshcore_repeater_sample_time_seconds{device=~"${device:regex}",peer=~"${peer:regex}"}[$history]))) and (meshcore_repeater_fresh{device=~"${device:regex}",peer=~"${peer:regex}"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(meshcore_repeater_fresh{device=~"${device:regex}",peer=~"${peer:regex}"}) < 360)) and (distinct_over_time(meshcore_repeater_sample_time_seconds{device=~"${device:regex}",peer=~"${peer:regex}"}[30m]) >= 4) and (tlast_over_time(meshcore_repeater_battery_volts{device=~"${device:regex}",peer=~"${peer:regex}"}[30m]) - tfirst_over_time(meshcore_repeater_battery_volts{device=~"${device:regex}",peer=~"${peer:regex}"}[30m]) >= 1200))

panels.title: Battery voltage trend · V/hour
panels.description: Least-squares slope of time-weighted voltage over 30 minutes (one-minute steps, holds capped at six minutes). Requires fresh status, four distinct RF observations spanning 20 minutes, agreeing half-window slopes, and movement above scatter and 0.005 V/hour. Missing means no stable estimate.

panels.title: Approximate time to selected voltage limit
panels.description: Linear voltage projection at the stable 30-minute rate: falling voltage to Low battery voltage, rising voltage to Full voltage. Defaults are 3.3 V low and 4.2 V full for 1S parallel Li-ion packs. Set limits for the selected battery; 0 disables that direction. The low limit is not empty or zero state of charge. Voltage is not state of charge or usable energy. Solar, load, chemistry and temperature can change the result. At the limit: zero; stale, sparse, flat or changing trends: no estimate.
